title: John B. Wells Tops 2026 Paranormal 13 Show Rankings

John B. Wells Tops 2026 Paranormal 13 Show Rankings


Paranormal Radio

Talk Stream Live's Paranormal Radio has released its 2026 "Paranormal 13" rankings, with "Ark, Caravan to Midnight with John B. Wells" leading the Top Shows category. Art Bell U7 Radio ranked first among stations, while "Into The Parabnormal with Jeremy Scott" topped the podcast list.

The annual report ranks paranormal shows, stations and podcasts based on listener sessions through Talk Stream Live's Paranormal Radio streaming platforms, including its website, apps and connected devices. Rankings are limited to programs and stations listed on the service.

Wells moved into the top show position after finishing second in 2025, trading places with "Ground Zero with Clyde Lewis." "Coast to Coast AM with George Noory" remained third, followed by "Into The Parabnormal with Jeremy Scott" and Richard C. Hoagland's "The Other Side of Midnight."

Art Bell U7 Radio retained its lead among stations, followed by Conspiracy Radio and The UN X Network. In podcasts, "Into The Parabnormal" and "Ground Zero" again held the first two positions, with Whitley Strieber's "Dreamland The Edge of the World" placing third.

The rankings cover programming exploring subjects including supernatural phenomena, UFOs, extraterrestrial life, ghosts, cryptozoology, conspiracy theories and unexplained events.
